_comment: Glacial collection (frost, glacier ice and frozen-in looks, not the clear carved Ice Sculptures of #7). Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed glacial-permafrost`, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_glacial.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Glacial
readme.summary: Pokemon in the grip of the deep cold: frostbitten, glacier ice, permafrost, aurora ice, frozen solid or snowed in.
looks: each line wears one look: frostbite, its own colours frosted white with rime feathers creeping in from the edges (Rattata, Taillow, Ledyba); glacier, deep blue banded glacier ice with a snow cap and crevasses (Golett, Duraludon, Diancie); permafrost, frozen dark earth threaded with ice lenses and hoarfrost (Sandshrew, Wimpod, Wo-Chien); aurora ice, pale ice that the northern lights shimmer across (Noibat, Staryu, Plusle); frozen in, its own colours seen through a block of blue ice with bubbles and white cracks (Mareanie, Turtonator, Dracozolt); blizzard, crusted in snow with snowflakes and wind-blown streaks (Litwick, Milcery, Gossifleur)
the ice glints and sparkles in the dark, the aurora ripples; icy glowing eyes
shiny: the ice's light turned round the colour wheel
